part.text:
Fix verified. The change in tree.go adds `cap(*params) > 0` to the param/catchAll save branches (matching upstream PR #2755), preventing the `slice bounds out of range` panic when `HandleContext` is called on a context whose params slice was allocated before routes were registered.

- Repro program now prints "We should get here" instead of panicking
- Full test suite (`go test ./...`) passes, including the FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS cases
